title: Jobs Week view: create new job for a specific date by clicking a day column
tech: Node.js, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma 6, Zod, Vitest, React 18, Vite, CSS Modules, Axios
keyConstraints: TypeScript strict mode, Zod validation server-side, .nullish() not .optional().nullable(), Prisma selects must include all returned fields (jobInclude is source of truth), no UI component libraries, CSS Modules only
description: In the Jobs page Week view, clicking the empty area of a day column opens the existing New Job form with the scheduled start date pre-filled to the clicked day. This lets a dispatcher create a job for a specific date directly from the calendar instead of opening New Job and picking the date manually. Reuse the existing New Job form/modal — only add the entry point and date pre-fill.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the empty area of a day column in Week view opens the existing New Job form.
The scheduled start date field is pre-filled with the clicked day's date; time portion defaults to 08:00 and remains editable.
Clicking an existing job card inside a day column does NOT open the New Job form (stopPropagation) — existing card click behavior is unchanged.
After successful creation, the new job appears in the correct day column of Week view without a manual page reload.
Day columns show a pointer cursor and a hover state to signal clickability; labels support EN/FI via the existing i18n mechanism.
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no errors.
implementationNotes: Do not rewrite working code — only add the day-click entry point and an optional initialDate prop to the existing New Job form.
Reuse the existing New Job form/modal component; do not create a duplicate form.
CSS Modules only — no inline styles, no UI component libraries.
Datetime inputs: convert to .toISOString() before sending to API.
Pre-fill must respect local timezone — the clicked day in the UI must equal the date shown in the form (avoid UTC off-by-one).
The New Job header button must keep working exactly as before (opens form with no pre-filled date or today's date, whichever is current behavior).
securityConsiderations: No new endpoints. Creation goes through the existing job creation flow with existing server-side Zod validation and role checks.
